description:
Create the canonical plan-of-record that the contribution-triage team maintains and the customer-side outbound pipeline reads to decide what counts as submittable. Define: location in the repo, document structure (what rules, what examples, what anti-patterns), the distribution mechanism (ships as part of project updates, read by customer-side classifier at runtime), and versioning so customer-side pipelines can track which ruleset they're running.

Also establishes the team's typed evidence topics and the promotion ritual that moves insights from typed evidence → plan-of-record.
name: submission-guidelines-plan-of-record
title: Establish submission-guidelines plan-of-record document
